business_problem: Malabar Gold and Diamonds needed to replace multiple legacy ERP systems that fragmented finance, inventory, retail, and export processes and could not scale securely with seasonal demand.
solution_summary: Malabar Gold and Diamonds had different systems for retail, inventory, and finance, making it difficult to get a single integrated view of the business or keep infrastructure costs and performance under control. The company chose a cloud ERP and commerce stack that could centralize master data, standardize processes, and support back-office, export, bullion, supply-chain, and store operations in one extensible environment. Key components include Dynamics 365 Finance supports core back-office financial processes on the unified business platform; Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management manages export, bullion, supply-chain, and inventory processes with shared master data; Dynamics 365 Commerce runs retail operations and point-of-sale workflows across the store network. Malabar Gold now has centralized master data management, comprehensive financial reporting, inventory visibility, efficient POS operations, and a platform that can scale during peak seasonal demand.
